entries.headline: Nvidia tells partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as US tightens China chip access rules
entries.summary: Nvidia told manufacturing partners to halt shipments to four Southeast Asian countries after a new US rule requiring licenses for advanced AI chip purchases. GPU sellers are also restricting neocloud sales over Chinese remote access.

entries.headline: Anthropic goes public as ANT, then slips after debut
entries.summary: Anthropic's IPO began trading and shares fell after the debut, failing to calm AI worries.

entries.headline: SAP preparing to cut at least 10,000 jobs, about 9% of staff, in AI restructuring
entries.summary: Bloomberg reports SAP is planning to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to transform its software business for the AI era.

entries.headline: US chip curbs and distillation crackdown delay Chinese AI models; Z.ai's GLM-5.5 reportedly slips
entries.summary: Reuters sources say US chip curbs and distillation curbs threaten Chinese AI development. Z.ai's flagship GLM-5.5 missed its November release and could slip to Q1 2027, and Moonshot expects longer gaps between releases.

entries.headline: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after ethics breach; questions over governance
entries.summary: Trump says Huang is excited about a 'second term' at Nvidia after his reinstatement. The FT and others question the company's governance after Huang's code of conduct violation.

entries.headline: Dutch government to resist US MATCH Act restricting ASML sales to China
entries.summary: The Netherlands says it will oppose and ask Washington not to enforce the proposed rules, calling them a threat to ASML.

entries.headline: Singapore in talks with US to retain AI chip access as Washington closes remote-access loophole
entries.summary: Singapore's deputy PM said it is talking with the US to keep access to advanced chips, while saying it has yet to confirm Nvidia's halt. Fitch says the curbs will slow Asia data-center investment.

entries.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic researchers warn new models may be too powerful to release safely
entries.summary: Axios reports researchers at both labs warn about powerful models; OpenAI's chief scientist proposes shared limits on frontier development.

entries.headline: Bipartisan push to regulate AI in Congress faces slow legislating and turf battles
entries.summary: Members of both parties want to tackle AI policy but face obstacles.

entries.headline: SoftBank credit risk rises as investors fret over AI bets
entries.summary: Investors see rising default risk, with CDS at a 4-year high and pressure on its retail bond.

entries.headline: AI-linked market volatility hits Asia and Taiwan as Nvidia saga unsettles stocks
entries.summary: Asian stocks swung after Huang's return, foreign funds are on pace for a record Taiwan exodus, and global stocks recovered after volatile US trading over AI risks.

entries.headline: Bank of England warns of AI borrowing risks and encryption threats from unreleased AI models
entries.summary: The BoE sees growing financial risks as AI borrowing surges and Bailey says unreleased models raise encryption concerns, calling for global testing.

entries.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI sketch plans to share wealth ahead of IPOs; OpenAI IPO clock ticking
entries.summary: Anthropic and OpenAI are outlining wealth-sharing plans, while the WSJ says OpenAI's IPO countdown is ticking. Anthropic employees have become AI billionaires.

entries.headline: US approves Musk's Starmind plan for a million data-center satellites
entries.summary: Regulators authorised launch of the Starmind constellation for AI computing.

entries.headline: ElevenLabs in early talks to raise at $33 billion valuation
entries.summary: Bloomberg reports early funding talks.

entries.headline: Meta refused UK FCA joint testing request ahead of rolling out Muse personal agent
entries.summary: The FCA warned about agent risks after Meta declined.

entries.headline: 42 state AGs try to stop Character.AI selling user chats in bankruptcy
entries.summary: A coalition seeks to prevent sale of user data during Chapter 11.

entries.headline: Japan's JERA in talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres near power plants
entries.summary: Nikkei reports JERA is exploring data centers for the two companies.

entries.headline: Hochul vetoes AI safety bill; California governor seeks AI safety action; NY AG creates unit to enforce RAISE Act
entries.summary: State-level AI safety regulation developments across New York and California.

entries.headline: AI agents used in five cyber attacks in Switzerland
entries.summary: Swiss government reports.

entries.headline: Anthropic's Claude lets users turn artifacts into apps
entries.summary: New Claude feature.

entries.headline: Dario Amodei rejects surrendering free will to AI, criticizes rivals' 'vibes-based' positioning
entries.summary: Amodei distinguished governing by AI, which he opposes, from automating tasks.

entries.headline: AI power cost backlash threatens NextEra-Dominion deal; Texas resumes data centre permitting
entries.summary: Power bills anger spills into dealmaking.

entries.headline: UN calls for global framework on AI risks within a year
entries.summary: A UN special summit on AI safety stressed human-centric governance.

entries.headline: Thomson Reuters to launch AI model built on Chinese and US open-source models
entries.summary: It blends models to cut costs and control IP.

entries.headline: Undisclosed AI use affected dozens of court cases in England and Wales
entries.summary: Guardian found at least 25 cases with fake citations.

entries.headline: Avicena raises $100M+ Series C for microLED chip interconnects
entries.summary: SK Hynix, Samsung and AMD ventures joined.

entries.headline: AI shopping bots from Google, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI face holiday test
entries.summary: Bloomberg looks at holiday AI shopping.

entries.headline: Los Angeles blocks AI features as Google threatens schools' search access
entries.summary: AP report.

entries.headline: BharatGen launches open-weight Patram 1.5 document AI model
entries.summary: 7B-parameter model for Indian documents.
